name: Retail loan default predictor
purpose: Predict the probability that a retail loan applicant will default using their credit history and repayment records. Loan officers use the prediction when deciding whether to approve the application.

name: CV screening and applicant ranking
purpose: Screen submitted CVs and rank job applicants according to their qualifications and experience. Recruiters use the ranked list to decide whom to interview.

name: Email spam filter
purpose: Classify incoming email messages as spam or legitimate mail and route unwanted messages to a spam folder.

name: Banking FAQ chatbot
purpose: Answer customers' banking FAQ questions through a conversational customer-service chatbot. It explains opening hours, account features and routine service procedures.

name: Public authority social scoring
purpose: A public authority assigns citizens scores based on their social behaviour and personal characteristics. Officials use those scores to determine access to public benefits and services.

name: Card transaction fraud detector
purpose: Detect potentially fraudulent card transactions by analysing transaction patterns and device signals. Suspicious payments are sent to a fraud investigation team.

name: Life and health insurance pricing
purpose: Assess the insurance risk of individual applicants and calculate their life and health insurance premiums using personal and health information.

name: Exam cheating detection
purpose: Monitor students during examinations and detect behaviour that may indicate cheating. Invigilators review the alerts when deciding whether examination rules were breached.

name: Workplace employee emotion recognition
purpose: Infer employees' emotions from facial expressions and voice recordings in the workplace. Managers receive reports about the emotional state of their staff.

name: Marketing deepfake image generator
purpose: Generate realistic synthetic images depicting people for marketing campaigns, including images that resemble real individuals doing things they did not actually do.

name: E-commerce product recommender
purpose: Recommend products to online shoppers based on their browsing activity and purchase history. Suggestions help customers discover items in the catalogue.

name: Student admissions decision support
purpose: Evaluate student applications and recommend whether applicants should be admitted to an educational institution. Admissions staff use the recommendations in their decisions.

name: Internal PDF document type classifier
purpose: Classify incoming PDF documents into internal administrative categories such as invoices, forms and correspondence. It routes each file to the appropriate processing queue.

name: Employee promotion monitoring
purpose: Monitor employee performance using productivity and work-quality information. Managers use the assessments when deciding which employees to promote.

name: Internal portfolio capital model
purpose: Estimate aggregate capital requirements for an internal financial portfolio using portfolio-level exposures and scenarios. The model makes no decisions about individual customers or applicants.
